svg.text: s7_ctrl: mode control and switch matrix of slot 7 (tier 1, 2026-11-08)
Every harness bit (enable, dig_in0..5) is shifted to 3.3 V by one ls_up_fs (no 1.2 V supply; ~50 nA while its input is 1).
en / en_b = enable at 3.3 V (master enable of the slot); with en = 0 all switches are off.
Key: valid = d3 AND NOT d4 (k1, k0_b). s, m, f = swap / mon / feed qualified by valid; e_b = NOT (ext AND valid).
Switches (tg_hv, a -> b): ld: outp->vinp, outn->vinn | lx: outp->vinn, outn->vinp | sb: outp->bus0, outn->bus1
| bd: bus0->vinp, bus1->vinn | rc: vcm_rb->vcm_pad, vref_rb->vref_pad. vddh / vss: slot vdd_3v3 / vss_3v3.
Modes (dig_in, active only with the key dig_in3 = 1, dig_in4 = 0; otherwise the default):
dig_in0 swap: loop S2D -> D2S crossed (lx instead of ld)
dig_in1 mon: S2D outp / outn -> analog_bus0 / 1 (sb), loop stays on
dig_in2 feed: analog_bus0 / 1 -> D2S vinp / vinn (bd), loop off; wins over swap and mon
dig_in5 ext: pad_ref_rb disconnected (rc off), the pads take vcm / vref from analog_bus2 / 3
Default (enable = 1, no key): loop direct (ld), bus0 / 1 disconnected, pad_ref_rb drives vcm / vref (rc).
ld = en AND NOT f AND NOT s lx = en AND NOT f AND s
sb = en AND m AND NOT f bd = en AND f
rc = en AND NOT (ext AND valid)
Unused shifter outputs: sw_b, mon_b, fd_b, k1_b, k0, ex_b.
